answer: Apply correlation penalties: the ledger compares every pair of agents' action timing, answers and fund flows each epoch, and identities that move in lockstep, like grapes on one vine, split a single reward instead of each earning one. When a ring is caught, the slash scales with how many members acted together, so one fault becomes a ripple that hits the whole cluster. Hiding 1,000 sybils in the ocean of honest agents means running 1,000 truly independent operators with their own schedules, ideas and money, which costs as much as being honest.
